title: LP® SmartSide® ExpertFinish® Naturals Collection™ Siding: Natural Wood Beauty for Modern Living
summary: Discover LP® SmartSide® Naturals Collection™ siding, featuring premium wood-inspired finishes, engineered durability, and long-lasting curb appeal beauty for modern homes.
body_markdown:
Looking for the beauty of real wood without the constant upkeep? LP® SmartSide® ExpertFinish® Naturals Collection™ siding combines the authentic warmth of natural wood tones with the engineered durability homeowners, builders, and remodelers demand. Designed to deliver a premium wood-inspired appearance while helping resist hail and moisture, LP® SmartSide® ExpertFinish® Naturals Collection™ siding is redefining what homeowners can expect from engineered wood siding.


Whether you’re building a new home, planning an exterior renovation, or researching the latest siding trends, here’s what you need to know about LP® SmartSide® ExpertFinish® Naturals Collection™ siding.


**What is LP® SmartSide® ExpertFinish® Naturals Collection™ Siding?**


LP® SmartSide® ExpertFinish® Naturals Collection™ siding is an engineered wood siding and trim product featuring factory-applied natural wood tone finishes. Unlike traditional wood siding that requires staining, LP® SmartSide® ExpertFinish® Naturals Collection™ siding offers rich, nature-inspired colors with the strength and performance benefits of LP® SmartSide® products.


The collection was designed for those who love the timeless character of cedar, redwood, and other natural wood aesthetics with a durable solution.


**Key Features Include:**


-


Authentic wood-inspired color palette


-


Engineered wood substrate with proprietary SmartGuard® treatment


-


Factory-applied finish for consistent appearance


-


Available in a variety of siding profiles and trim options


-


Designed to complement modern, rustic, farmhouse, craftsman, and contemporary home styles


**Why Homeowners Are Choosing Natural Wood-Tone Siding**


Natural looking exterior materials continue to appear in residential design trends. Homeowners are increasingly drawn to warm, organic finishes that create visual depth and curb appeal.


Wood tone siding offers:


-


**Timeless Curb Appeal**


Natural finishes never go out of style. Whether paired with stone, brick, or metal accents, wood-inspired siding creates a sophisticated appearance that feels both modern and welcoming.


-


**Versatile Design Options**


From mountain retreats and lake homes to suburban neighborhoods, natural wood tones complement any architectural style.


-


**Long-term Performance and Durability**


LP® SmartSide® ExpertFinish® Naturals Collection™ siding is engineered to provide enhanced durability and resistance to common siding challenges while maintaining the authentic look homeowners crave.


**The LP Difference**


Not all wood-like siding products are created the same.


LP® SmartSide® ExpertFinish® Naturals Collection™ siding is engineered with the proprietary SmartGuard® treatment, which helps protect against fungal decay and termites. This innovative approach allows homeowners to achieve the warm look of wood while benefiting from the long-term durability and performance that these products bring.


**Backed by Industry Leading Warranty Protection**


Homeowners investing in premium siding want confidence in their purchase. LP® SmartSide® ExpertFinish® Naturals Collection™ siding is backed by an industry-leading 5/15/50-year prorated limited warranty, offering protection and peace of mind for years to come.


Refer to limited warranty at[lpcorp.com/literature](https://lpcorp.com/literature) for complete details, including important limitations and exclusions.


**Popular Design Trends Featuring the LP® SmartSide® ExpertFinish® Naturals Collection™ siding**


One of today’s most popular trends combine clean architectural lines with warm natural looking colors. Homeowners are pairing wood-tone siding with black windows, dark roofs, and minimalist landscaping to create a modern yet inviting exterior.


Builders and designers frequently pair this collection with:


-


Stone


-


Brick accents


-


Board and batten details


-


Metal roofing


-


Smooth architectural panels


This results in a layered exterior with texture, contrast, and visual appeal.


**Indoor-Outdoor Connection**


Natural materials help blur the line between indoor and outdoor living spaces. Warm wood-inspired siding colors create a seamless transition that feels connected to the surrounding landscape.


Applying LP® SmartSide® ExpertFinish® Naturals Collection™ siding on porch ceilings is a common trend among homeowners.


**Is LP® SmartSide® ExpertFinish® Naturals Collection™ Siding the Right Fit for Your Home?**


It is an ideal choice if you want:


-


The look of natural wood


-


Long-lasting curb appeal


-


A premium exterior aesthetic


-


Durability for varying weather conditions


-


Design flexibility across architectural styles


Whether you're updating a forever home or building a new custom residence, the LP® SmartSide® ExpertFinish® Naturals Collection™ siding provides an opportunity to achieve a refined natural appearance without sacrificing performance.


**Frequently Asked Questions**


**What makes LP® SmartSide® ExpertFinish® Naturals Collection™ siding different from traditional wood siding?**


LP® SmartSide® ExpertFinish® Naturals Collection™ siding combines factory-applied natural wood-tone finishes with engineered wood technology, helping homeowners achieve the appearance of wood while benefiting from enhanced durability and performance.


**Is LP® SmartSide® ExpertFinish® Naturals Collection™ siding available with matching trim?** Yes, the collection includes trim options designed to create a cohesive exterior appearance.


**Does natural wood-tone siding help improve curb appeal?**


Many homeowners and designers choose wood-inspired exteriors because they create warmth, texture, and visual interest that can help homes stand out.


**Elevate Your Exterior with LP® SmartSide® ExpertFinish® Naturals Collection™ Siding**


The best exterior designs balance beauty and performance. With rich wood-inspired finishes, engineered durability, and timeless appeal, LP® SmartSide® ExpertFinish® Naturals Collection™ siding helps homeowners achieve the natural look they love with confidence built into every board.
